exercises.instructionEn: Look at the picture and label the people with their names: Esmeralda - Quasimodo - Phoebus
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmga qarang va odamlarni ismlari bilan belgilang: Esmeralda - Kvazimodo - Feb
exercises.explanationUz:
RASMDA NIMA KO'RINADI:

  KATTA RASM — ikki kishi bir-biriga
  qarab turibdi:
     • Baland bo'yli, OCh RANGLI sochli,
       SOQOLLI erkak (yuqorida 'A' belgisi)
     • Uzun QORA sochli ayol (pastda 'B'
       belgisi)

  KIChIK RASM (ichkarida) — boshiga toj
  kiygan, qo'lini ko'targan odam
  ('C' belgisi). Atrofda konfetti uchmoqda
  — bu 'Festival of Fools' (Ahmoqlar
  bayrami) sahnasi.


JAVOBLAR:

  A = PHOEBUS
  B = ESMERALDA
  C = QUASIMODO


QANDAY ANIQLANADI:

  A — 5-mashqda Feb shunday tasvirlanadi:
     'He's got FAIR hair and a BEARD.'
     Rasmda erkakning sochi OCh RANGLI va
     SOQOLI bor → PHOEBUS.

  B — 4-mashqda Esmeralda shunday
     tasvirlanadi:
     'She's got LONG BLACK hair.'
     Rasmda ayolning sochi uzun va qora
     → ESMERALDA.

  C — 3-mashqda Kvazimodo tasvirlanadi.
     U — bukri qo'ng'iroqchi, toj kiygan
     (Ahmoqlar bayramida 'ahmoqlar qiroli'
     deb tanlangan) → QUASIMODO.


ISMLARNING TALAFFUZI:

  Esmeralda  /ˌezməˈrældə/  — Esmeralda
  Quasimodo  /ˌkwɑːzɪˈməʊdəʊ/ — Kvazimodo
  Phoebus    /ˈfiːbəs/      — Feb

  ⚠ 'Phoebus' dagi 'Ph' — /f/ deb
  o'qiladi (photo, phone kabi).


FILM HAQIDA QISQAChA:

  Viktor Gyugoning romani asosidagi Disney
  multfilmi (1996).

  Kvazimodo — Notr-Dam soborining bukri
  qo'ng'iroqchisi. Frollo uni sobordan
  chiqarmaydi. U Ahmoqlar bayramiga
  yashirincha boradi va u yerda
  raqqosa Esmeraldani uchratadi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to label   = belgilamoq, nom qo'ymoq
  a hunchback = bukri odam
  a bell-ringer = qo'ng'iroqchi
  a festival = bayram, festival

tasks.left: A — baland bo'yli, och rangli sochli, soqolli erkak
C — toj kiygan, qo'lini ko'targan odam (kichik rasm)

exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  B a church
  2  C Paris
  3  B Frollo
  4  A a festival
  5  B dancing


HAR BIRI NEGA:

 1  'What is Notre Dame?' → A ChURCh
    Notr-Dam — mashhur SOBOR (cathedral).
    'Cathedral' — katta cherkov, shuning
    uchun 'a church' to'g'ri.

    ⚠ 'a castle' = qal'a (qirol yashaydigan
       joy)
    ⚠ 'a tower' = minora — Notr-Damning
       minoralari bor, lekin o'zi minora
       emas.

 2  'Which city is it in?' → PARIS
    Notr-Dam — Parijda, Fransiya
    poytaxtida.

    ⚠ 8-nazorat testining 5-bandi ham shu:
    'He has already seen the Louvre but he
     hasn't seen NOTRE DAME yet.'
    Luvr ham, Notr-Dam ham — Parijda!

 3  'Who is Quasimodo's master?' → FROLLO
    Frollo — Kvazimodoni tarbiyalagan va
    uni sobordan chiqarmaydigan sudya.

    ⚠ 'Freddy' va 'Frilly' — o'xshash
    ovozli chalg'ituvchi variantlar
    (filmda bunday personajlar yo'q).

 4  'Where does Quasimodo want to go to?'
    → A FESTIVAL
    Kvazimodo 'Festival of Fools' (Ahmoqlar
    bayrami) ga bormoqchi.

    1-mashqdagi rasmda aynan shu sahna
    ko'rinadi (toj, konfetti).

 5  'What is Esmeralda doing there?'
    → DANCING
    Esmeralda — lo'li RAQQOSA, u bayramda
    raqsga tushadi.


⚠ 5-BAND GRAMMATIKASI:
  'What IS she DOING?' — PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
  Javob ham shu zamonda: 'She is DANCING.'

  (Unit 7-8 grammatikasi.)


⚠ 3-BANDDAGI EGALIK:
  'QUASIMODO'S master' = Kvazimodoning
  xo'jayini.

  Ismga apostrof + 's' qo'shiladi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a church   = cherkov
  a cathedral = sobor
  a castle   = qal'a
  a tower    = minora
  a master   = xo'jayin, ustoz
  a festival = bayram
  to dance   = raqsga tushmoq

exercises.instructionEn: Read the description of Quasimodo and correct the underlined words. 'Quasimodo is a 1) tall man. He's got 2) black hair and big 3) square eyes. He's got a 4) small nose and crooked teeth.'
exercises.instructionUz: Kvazimodoning tasvirini o'qing va tagi chizilgan so'zlarni tuzating.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI TASVIR (XATOLARI BILAN):

  'Quasimodo is a 1) TALL man. He's got
   2) BLACK hair and big 3) SQUARE eyes.
   He's got a 4) SMALL nose and crooked
   teeth.'


TO'G'RI TASVIR:

  'Quasimodo is a SHORT man. He's got RED
   hair and big ROUND eyes. He's got a BIG
   nose and crooked teeth.'

  Tarjimasi:
  'Kvazimodo — past bo'yli odam. Uning
   qizil sochi va katta dumaloq ko'zlari
   bor. Katta burni va qiyshiq tishlari
   bor.'


JAVOBLAR:
  1  tall   → SHORT
  2  black  → RED
  3  square → ROUND (yoki GREEN)
  4  small  → BIG


⚠ 3-BAND — IKKI VARIANT MUMKIN:

  Kitob to'g'ri javobni bosmagan.

  (a) 'ROUND' — 'square' (kvadrat) SHAKL
      so'zi, shuning uchun uni yana ShAKL
      so'zi bilan almashtirish eng
      to'g'ridan-to'g'ri tuzatish.
      Ko'z kvadrat bo'lmaydi — dumaloq
      bo'ladi.

  (b) 'GREEN' — Disney multfilmida
      Kvazimodoning ko'zlari YAShIL, va
      Unit 4 aynan KO'Z RANGI mavzusini
      o'rgatadi ('What colour are your
      eyes?').

  ⚠ Skaner OQ-QORA bo'lgani uchun rangni
  tekshirib bo'lmadi. Ikkala javob ham
  asosli.

  ⚠ DIQQAT: 4-mashqda Esmeralda haqida
  'She's got big GREEN eyes' degan TO'G'RI
  gap bor. Agar Kvazimododa ham yashil
  ko'z bo'lsa, kitob takrorlagan bo'lardi —
  bu 'ROUND' foydasiga zaif dalil.


QOLGAN BANDLAR:

 1  'tall' → SHORT
    Kvazimodo — BUKRI, shuning uchun past
    bo'yli ko'rinadi.
    tall (baland bo'yli) ↔ short (past
    bo'yli)

 2  'black' → RED
    Disney multfilmida Kvazimodoning sochi
    QIZG'ISh-SARIQ.
    (Qora soch — Esmeraldada, 4-mashq.)

 4  'small' → BIG
    Kvazimodoning burni KATTA — bu uning
    eng ko'zga tashlanadigan belgisi.
    small (kichik) ↔ big (katta)


⚠ 'CROOKED TEETH' — TAGI ChIZILMAGAN:

  'crooked teeth' = qiyshiq tishlar

  Bu so'z TO'G'RI, shuning uchun
  tuzatilmaydi. Kitob faqat TAGI ChIZILGAN
  so'zlarni tuzatishni so'raydi.

  ⚠ 'tooth' ning ko'pligi — TEETH
  (noto'g'ri ko'plik!).


UNIT 4 BILAN BOG'LIQ:

  Bu mashq Unit 4 ning ('Like Father, like
  Son') asosiy mavzusini takrorlaydi:

     'What does he LOOK LIKE?'
     → tall/short, big/small nose,
       black/red hair, green/blue eyes


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  short      = past bo'yli
  red hair   = qizg'ish soch
  round      = dumaloq
  square     = kvadrat
  crooked    = qiyshiq
  teeth (tooth) = tishlar (tish)

tasks.whyUz:

tall (baland bo'yli) ↔ SHORT (past bo'yli)

QORA soch — ESMERALDADA (4-mashq:
'She's got long BLACK hair').

Kitob ataylab ikkalasini chalkashtirmoqda.

ASOSLI:

    to'g'ridan-to'g'ri tuzatish.
(b) GREEN — filmda Kvazimodoning ko'zlari

Skaner OQ-QORA — rangni tekshirib bo'lmadi.

Kvazimodoning burni KATTA — bu uning eng
ko'zga tashlanadigan belgisi.

small (kichik) ↔ BIG (katta)

(6-mashqda Frolloning burni 'HOOKED' —
qiyshiq/burgutsimon.)

exercises.instructionEn: Tick the sentences which describe Esmeralda.
exercises.explanationUz:
YETTI GAP — UChTASI TO'G'RI:

  ✓ She's got long black hair.
  ✗ She wears a black dress.
  ✗ She's got small brown eyes.
  ✓ She's got red lips.
  ✓ She's got big green eyes.
  ✗ She's got short red hair.
  ✗ She has got a gold watch.


HAR BIRI NEGA:

 ✓ 'She's got LONG BLACK hair.'
   1-mashqdagi rasmda Esmeraldaning sochi
   UZUN va QORA.

 ✗ 'She wears a BLACK dress.'
   Filmda Esmeraldaning ko'ylagi BINAFShA
   (qora emas).

 ✗ 'She's got SMALL BROWN eyes.'
   Ikki xato: ko'zlari KATTA va YAShIL.

 ✓ 'She's got RED lips.'
   To'g'ri.

 ✓ 'She's got BIG GREEN eyes.'
   To'g'ri — Esmeraldaning eng mashhur
   belgisi.

 ✗ 'She's got SHORT RED hair.'
   Ikki xato: sochi UZUN va QORA.
   ⚠ QIZIL soch — KVAZIMODODA (3-mashq)!

 ✗ 'She has got a GOLD WATCH.'
   ⚠ Film O'RTA ASRLARDA bo'lib o'tadi —
   o'shanda qo'l soati YO'Q edi!
   Esmeraldada oltin ZIRAK bor, soat emas.


⚠ ZID JUFTLIKLAR — KITOBNING USULI:

  Kitob har to'g'ri gapga ZID noto'g'ri
  gap qo'ygan:

     'long black hair'  ✓
     'short red hair'   ✗ (ikkala so'z ham
                          zid)

     'big green eyes'   ✓
     'small brown eyes' ✗ (ikkala so'z ham
                          zid)

  Bu — diqqatni tekshirish usuli.


⚠ 'GOLD WATCH' — TARIXIY XATO:

  Bu gap eng aldamchisi, chunki grammatik
  jihatdan to'g'ri va oddiy ko'rinadi.

  Lekin film 1482-yilda bo'lib o'tadi —
  qo'l soati faqat 16-asrda paydo bo'lgan.


DIQQAT — 'WEAR' va 'HAVE GOT':

  'She WEARS a dress.' — kiyim uchun
  'She'S GOT green eyes.' — tana a'zolari
     uchun

  ⚠ 'She has got a dress' ham to'g'ri, lekin
  'wear' aniqroq (aynan kiyib turibdi).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to tick    = belgilamoq (✓)
  a dress    = ko'ylak
  lips       = lablar
  gold       = oltin
  a watch    = qo'l soati

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the description of Phoebus with the words below.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi so'zlar bilan Febning tasvirini to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (6 ta so'z):
  tall, brave, handsome, fair, beard, blue


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  tall
  2  handsome
  3  fair
  4  beard
  5  blue
  6  brave


TO'LIQ TASVIR:

  'Phoebus is TALL and very HANDSOME. He's
   got FAIR hair and a BEARD. He wears a
   long BLUE cloak. Phoebus is also a very
   BRAVE man.'

  Tarjimasi:
  'Feb baland bo'yli va juda kelishgan.
   Uning och rangli sochi va soqoli bor. U
   uzun ko'k plash kiyadi. Feb, shuningdek,
   juda jasur odam.'


HAR BIRI QANDAY ANIQLANADI:

  ⚠ SO'ZNING TURIGA qarang:

  1  'Phoebus is 1)........'
     'is' dan keyin SIFAT → tall / handsome /
     brave / fair
     Rasmda u BALAND bo'yli → TALL

  2  'and very 2)........'
     'very' dan keyin SIFAT.
     Tashqi ko'rinish davom etmoqda
     → HANDSOME (kelishgan)

  3  '3)........ hair'
     'hair' dan OLDIN — soch RANGI
     → FAIR (och rangli, sarg'ish)

  4  'and a 4)........'
     'a' dan keyin — OT kerak!
     Ro'yxatdagi yagona ot → BEARD (soqol)

  5  'a long 5)........ cloak'
     'cloak' dan oldin — RANG
     → BLUE (Feb — kapitan, ko'k formada)

  6  'a very 6)........ man'
     'man' dan oldin — XARAKTER
     → BRAVE (jasur)


⚠ MUHIM USUL — 4-BAND:

  Ro'yxatda 6 ta so'z bor, lekin faqat
  BITTASI OT: 'beard'.

  Qolgan 5 tasi SIFAT: tall, brave,
  handsome, fair, blue.

  'and A 4)........' — artikl 'a' bor,
  demak OT kerak → BEARD.

  Bu — eng oson topiladigan band!


⚠ 2 va 6-BANDLAR FARQI:

  2  HANDSOME — TAShQI KO'RINISh
  6  BRAVE — XARAKTER

  Kitob 'Phoebus is ALSO a very brave man'
  deydi — 'also' (shuningdek) yangi jihat
  qo'shilishini bildiradi.

  Ya'ni avval TAShQI KO'RINISh, keyin
  XARAKTER.

  (Unit 4 ning asosiy farqi!)


DIQQAT — 'FAIR':
  'fair hair' = och rangli, sarg'ish soch
  'fair skin' = oq teri

  ⚠ 'fair' ning boshqa ma'nosi — 'adolatli'
  ('It's not fair!').


DIQQAT — 'HANDSOME' va 'BEAUTIFUL':
  handsome — ERKAK haqida (kelishgan)
  beautiful — odatda AYOL haqida (go'zal)
  good-looking — ikkalasi uchun


DIQQAT — 'A BEARD':
  'He's got A beard.' — artikl bilan.
  'a beard' = soqol
  'a moustache' = mo'ylov


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  handsome   = kelishgan (erkak)
  fair       = och rangli, sarg'ish
  a beard    = soqol
  a cloak    = plash, yopinchiq
  brave      = jasur

tasks.whyUz:
'is' dan keyin SIFAT kerak.

Rasmda Feb BALAND bo'yli → TALL.

⚠ 3-mashq bilan solishtiring: Kvazimodo
'SHORT' (past bo'yli).

'very' dan keyin SIFAT; tashqi ko'rinish
davom etmoqda → HANDSOME (kelishgan).

⚠ 'handsome' — ERKAK haqida;
'beautiful' — odatda ayol haqida.

'hair' dan OLDIN — soch RANGI → FAIR
(och rangli, sarg'ish).

1-mashqda A ni aniqlash kaliti aynan shu edi.

⚠ 'fair' ning boshqa ma'nosi — 'adolatli'.

⚠ ENG OSON BAND!

'and A ...' — artikl 'a' bor, demak OT kerak.
Ro'yxatdagi YAGONA ot → BEARD.

Qolgan 5 tasi sifat.

'a beard' = soqol; 'a moustache' = mo'ylov.

'cloak' dan oldin — RANG → BLUE.

Feb — soqchilar KAPITANI, ko'k formada.

'a cloak' = plash, yopinchiq.

tasks.prompt: Phoebus is also a very 6) ..................... man.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ 'ALSO' (shuningdek) yangi jihat qo'shadi:
avval TASHQI KO'RINISH, endi XARAKTER.

→ BRAVE (jasur).

Unit 4 ning asosiy farqi:
'What does he LOOK LIKE?' ↔ 'What IS he
LIKE?'

exercises.instructionEn: Describe Frollo, using the words in the box: hooked, grey, thin, black
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi so'zlardan foydalanib Frolloni tasvirlang: hooked, grey, thin, black
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (4 ta so'z):
  hooked, grey, thin, black


NAMUNA JAVOB:

  'Frollo is a tall THIN man. He's got GREY
   hair and a HOOKED nose. He wears a long
   BLACK cloak.'

  Tarjimasi:
  'Frollo — baland bo'yli, ozg'in odam.
   Uning kulrang sochi va burgutsimon burni
   bor. U uzun qora plash kiyadi.'


⚠ BU MAShQ OChIQ JAVOBLI:
  Kitob to'g'ri javobni bosmagan — o'zingiz
  gap tuzishingiz kerak. To'rt so'zning
  HAMMASINI ishlatish shart.


HAR SO'Z QAYERGA MOS KELADI:

  THIN (ozg'in) → odamning gavdasi
     'Frollo is a THIN man.'
     ⚠ thin ↔ fat (semiz)

  GREY (kulrang) → SOCh rangi
     'He's got GREY hair.'
     ⚠ Frollo — keksa odam, sochi kulrang.

  HOOKED (qiyshiq, burgutsimon) → BURUN
     'He's got a HOOKED nose.'
     ⚠ 'a hooked nose' = burgut burni kabi
     egilgan burun.
     'a hook' = ilmoq.

  BLACK (qora) → KIYIM rangi
     'He wears a long BLACK cloak.'
     ⚠ Frollo — sudya, qora kiyim kiyadi.


⚠ 5-MAShQ QOLIPINI TAKRORLANG:

  Feb tasviri qanday tuzilgan bo'lsa,
  Frolloni ham shunday tasvirlang:

     'X is ... and very ... .'
     'He's got ... hair and a ... .'
     'He wears a long ... cloak.'
     'X is also a very ... man.'

  Bu — tayyor QOLIP!


BOShQA MUMKIN VARIANTLAR:

  'Frollo is a THIN man with GREY hair. He's
   got a HOOKED nose and he wears a long
   BLACK cloak.'

  'Frollo is tall and THIN. He's got GREY
   hair and a HOOKED nose. His cloak is
   BLACK.'


⚠ FROLLO va PHOEBUS — ZID PERSONAJLAR:

  PHOEBUS:  tall, handsome, FAIR hair,
            BEARD, BLUE cloak, BRAVE
  FROLLO:   THIN, GREY hair, HOOKED nose,
            BLACK cloak

  Kitob ataylab ikkalasini qarama-qarshi
  qo'ygan:
     och rang (fair/blue) ↔ to'q rang
        (grey/black)
     jasur qahramon ↔ yovuz sudya


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  thin       = ozg'in
  fat        = semiz
  grey       = kulrang
  hooked     = qiyshiq, burgutsimon
  a hook     = ilmoq
  a judge    = sudya

exercises.instructionUz: T (to'g'ri) yoki F (noto'g'ri) deb javob bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'RT GAP — FAQAT BITTASI TO'G'RI:

  a)  F
  b)  F
  c)  T
  d)  F


HAR BIRI NEGA:

 a) 'Phoebus wants to KILL Esmeralda.' → F

    ✗ Aksincha — Feb Esmeraldani HIMOYA
    QILADI va unga oshiq bo'ladi.

    Esmeraldani o'ldirmoqchi bo'lgan —
    FROLLO.

    ⚠ Kitob ismlarni almashtirib qo'ygan
    (a va d bandlarida).

 b) 'Quasimodo lives in the GARAGE.' → F

    ✗ Kvazimodo Notr-Dam soborining
    QO'NG'IROQ MINORASIDA (bell tower)
    yashaydi.

    ⚠ Film O'RTA ASRLARDA bo'lib o'tadi —
    o'shanda GARAJ degan narsa YO'Q edi
    (mashina ham yo'q edi)!

    Bu — 4-mashqdagi 'gold watch' bilan
    bir xil turdagi TARIXIY xato.

 c) 'Frollo tries to BURN Esmeralda.' → T

    ✓ TO'G'RI. Frollo Esmeraldani gulxanda
    yoqmoqchi bo'ladi, lekin Kvazimodo uni
    qutqaradi.

    ⚠ 'try TO do something' = qilishga
    harakat qilmoq.

 d) 'Esmeralda falls in love with FROLLO.'
    → F

    ✗ Esmeralda FEBGA oshiq bo'ladi,
    Frolloga emas.

    ⚠ 'fall in love WITH somebody' —
    predlog 'with' SHART.
    fall → fell → fallen


⚠ KITOBNING USULI — ISMLARNI ALMAShTIRISh:

  a) 'PHOEBUS wants to kill' →
     aslida FROLLO
  d) 'falls in love with FROLLO' →
     aslida FEB bilan

  Ya'ni ikki bandda ISMLAR o'rin
  almashtirilgan.

  Bu — filmni diqqat bilan ko'rganini
  tekshirish usuli.


⚠ FILMNING QISQAChA MAZMUNI:

  Frollo (yovuz sudya) — Kvazimodoni
  sobordan chiqarmaydi.
  Kvazimodo Ahmoqlar bayramiga qochib
  boradi va Esmeraldani uchratadi.
  Frollo Esmeraldani yoqmoqchi bo'ladi.
  Kvazimodo uni qutqaradi.
  Esmeralda va Feb bir-biriga oshiq
  bo'lishadi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to kill    = o'ldirmoq
  a garage   = garaj
  a bell tower = qo'ng'iroq minorasi
  to burn    = yoqmoq
  to fall in love with = ... ga oshiq bo'lmoq
  to try to  = qilishga harakat qilmoq

exercises.explanationUz:
UChTA OChIQ SAVOL:

 1  'Who is the character in the film you
     liked most? Why?'
    = Filmdagi qaysi personaj sizga eng
      ko'p yoqdi? Nega?

 2  'Do you think Quasimodo is a good man
     or a bad man? Why?'
    = Sizningcha, Kvazimodo yaxshi odammi
      yoki yomonmi? Nega?

 3  'What are the things you like most
     about your best friend?'
    = Eng yaxshi do'stingizda sizga eng
      ko'p nima yoqadi?


⚠ BU MAShQ OChIQ JAVOBLI:
  To'g'ri javob yo'q — o'z fikringizni
  aytishingiz kerak.


JAVOB BERISh QOLIPLARI:

 1-SAVOL uchun:
    'I liked ... most because he/she is
     ... .'
    'My favourite character is ... because
     ... .'

    Masalan:
    'I liked Quasimodo most because he is
     kind and brave.'
    (Menga Kvazimodo eng ko'p yoqdi, chunki
     u mehribon va jasur.)

 2-SAVOL uchun:
    'I think Quasimodo is a GOOD man
     because he saves Esmeralda.'
    (Menimcha, Kvazimodo yaxshi odam,
     chunki u Esmeraldani qutqaradi.)

    ⚠ 'I think ...' = menimcha
    ⚠ 'because ...' = chunki

 3-SAVOL uchun:
    'My best friend is ... . I like him/her
     because he/she is ... .'

    Foydali sifatlar:
       kind (mehribon)
       funny (kulgili)
       honest (halol)
       helpful (yordamchi)
       friendly (do'stona)
       generous (saxiy)
       patient (sabrli)


⚠ 2 va 3-SAVOLLAR UNIT 4 GA BOG'LIQ:

  Ikkalasi ham XARAKTER haqida
  ('What is he LIKE?'), tashqi ko'rinish
  emas.

  Bu — filmning asosiy g'oyasi:
  Kvazimodo tashqi ko'rinishi bilan
  ChIROYLI emas, lekin XARAKTERI go'zal.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a character = personaj
  a discussion = muhokama
  most        = eng ko'p
  kind        = mehribon
  honest      = halol
  generous    = saxiy
  patient     = sabrli
